channel.title: The Philosophical Ledger — Writing
channel.description: Essays and field notes by Gagan Sachdeva on agentic AI, institutional trust, banking, governance, and the operating model of enterprises.

item.title: Context Is The Moat
item.description: Enterprise AI will not be won by the largest context window. It will be won by the institution that can safely admit useful context, operate agents with control, and evaluate the trace of work.

item.title: The Empty Window
item.description: Context windows grew five thousandfold; the context an enterprise can supply did not move. Includes a weekend spent building the instrument to measure it — what the papers changed, what broke, and why the measurement problem turns out to have no bottom.

item.title: The Capability–Value Gap
item.description: Intelligence may be the largest market ever created — but once models cross the sufficiency threshold, each extra unit of general intelligence buys less enterprise value. The advantage moves to the system around the model.

item.title: When Intelligence Gets Arms and Legs
item.description: When AI stops answering and starts acting, advantage leaves the model. Follow the bottleneck, bound the blast radius, own the learning loop — and build the control plane that does all three.

item.title: The Amnesia Tax
item.description: AI captures the answer and forgets the judgment behind it. The escape is a governed learning loop where decisions compound.

item.title: The Levels, Revisited for Agents
item.description: The agentic era adds Trust and Memory to the old maturity test — the two dimensions that decide whether agents are more than demos.

item.title: Control Planes Are Becoming the New Cloud Regions
item.description: Why the procurement unit of enterprise AI is shifting from models to the governed plane they run on — and who is positioned to own it.

item.title: The Levels of an AI-Pilled Organization
item.description: Six levels, four diagnostic questions, public cases, and how to climb.

item.title: Why Trace-First Agent Systems Matter
item.description: Serious teams evaluate agents at the trace level before they trust them — the same way auditors read ledgers, not summaries.

item.title: The Gap Is The Equation
item.description: 80% of enterprises are building AI agents; 6% are getting results. Capacity is architecture × governance × knowledge.
